name: Investigations in Contemporary Global Political Thought
description: This course investigates how democracies across the world are moving away from liberal principles and facilitating the rise of illiberal, populist and authoritarian regimes across the world. It undertakes a critical examination of various constituent concepts of political liberalism and their internal contradictions; the ongoing debates regarding the compatibility of authoritarian and populist regimes with political democracies; the inherently paradoxical relationship between the concepts of liberalism, democracy, and representation; central tenets of cold war liberalism and neoliberalism; the arguments of their conservative and radical critics; the central tenets of globally ascendent populism; and the conceptual correlations between populism and neoliberalism.
